title: Passage and Monsoon
author: Ines Vane
blurb: Elodie Joubert, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
